title: Without View and Manage AP/AR Data, Edit Customer keeps the saved payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Customers → Create & Edit' but not 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's Edit Customer window.
  2. Change the phone number to a new one.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open customer A's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No "Bill Invoices To" field and no help line show.
  • No empty gap is left where the field would be.

Step 2:

  • The phone field shows the new phone number.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • The left card still shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name: saving did not remove it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-N1: “Without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', the field is hidden and the window closes up around it.”
  • Key Decisions: “Setting or removing a saved default Bill To needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' (the Credit Terms pattern).”
  • Key Decisions: “Anyone who can view the customer or work order sees the Bill To.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • “No "Bill Invoices To" field; the window closes up around it.”
